Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Leigh Hunt (author, Wikidata Q655213), died 1859; Dante Alighieri (other, Wikidata Q1067), died 1321; Luigi Pulci (other, Wikidata Q631635), died 1484. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Hunt, Leigh, 1784-1859; Dante Alighieri, 1265-1321 [Contributor]; Pulci, Luigi, 1432-1484 [Contributor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Stories from the Italian poets : with lives of the writers, London : Chapman and Hall, 1846, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/storiesfromitali01hunt. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 70%, 100%, 100% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Dante Alighieri, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
